title: Industrial warehouse yard
goal: Show warehouse operations, vehicle circulation, parking, and fire access.

rubric.must: The plan visibly shows the Warehouse and Operations Office footprints.
The plan visibly shows the heavy-vehicle loop and truck gate.
The plan visibly shows visitor parking and trailer staging yard.
A north arrow and scale bar are visible.
A closed site boundary and street frontage are visibly distinguishable.
Supporting callouts, markers, and a legend are visible and readable.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the siteplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The plan visibly includes both building footprints, the heavy-vehicle loop and truck gate, visitor parking and trailer staging, a north arrow and scale bar, a closed site boundary distinct from the street frontage, and readable supporting annotations and legend. No material overlap or cropping is apparent.

items.evidence: Labeled Warehouse and Operations Office footprints are both drawn and dimensioned.
The heavy-vehicle loop is labeled with its 14 m width, and a truck gate is marked along Logistics Parkway.
Visitor Parking is labeled with 32 spaces, and the Trailer Staging Yard is labeled with dimensions and area.
A north arrow and a graphic scale marked from 0 to 100 m are visible.
A closed dashed operational site boundary surrounds the plan; Logistics Parkway is separately shown as the street frontage.
The plan includes a readable legend, fire-route note and dashed route, hydrant marker, loading-docks callout, security-fence label, and pedestrian-route label.
